arms.label: web3ctx
arms.calledHow: POST /mcp, tools/call web3_search, query only. 🔴 NO `intent` argument — F76 says a real client may not send it, and measuring ourselves under our best argument is what M1 was criticised for. The `intent: "integrate"` row is separate and labelled.

arms.label: web3ctx (intent=integrate)
arms.calledHow: Identical, plus `intent: "integrate"` — the argument that activates the recipe arm. Labelled, never merged with the primary row.

arms.label: context7
arms.calledHow: Public HTTPS endpoint `mcp.context7.com/mcp`, its documented two-step: resolve-library-id then get-library-docs. 🔴 Its earlier VOID was an installation gap in one session, NOT a verdict — reached here over HTTP with no installation at all.

arms.label: exa (code context)
arms.calledHow: get_code_context_exa — "Best for: Any programming question", per its own docs. ⚠ In the 2026-08-13 audit only web search was measured and this product was UNMEASURED.

arms.label: exa (web search)
arms.calledHow: web_search_exa — the arm the 2026-08-13 audit measured, kept so the two are comparable.

arms.label: claude web search
arms.calledHow: Anthropic Messages API with the `web_search` server tool, raw HTTP. 🔴 The key is read from a 0600 file at call time, never stored in the harness, never logged, and asserted to reach no host but api.anthropic.com.

arms.label: firecrawl (developer search)
arms.calledHow: Documented search API with `categories: ["developer"]` — the DEDICATED developer surface, which its own docs name for "a developer question — code behaviour, a library or framework, an API contract". ⚠ The 2026-08-13 audit called the generic surface. `categories` is a MODE SELECTOR, not an answer hint.
